name: Shri Rajneesh Kumar Agrawal
education: B.Sc. (Electronics Science), Bachelor of Communication and Journalism, Master in Broadcasting Journalism Educated at Dr. Harisingh Gour University, Sagar, Madhya Pradesh and Makhanlal Chaturvedi National University of Journalism and Communication, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
permanent_address: E-114/20, Shivaji Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462001
social_activities: Has actively contributed to the dissemination of national, cultural and ideological thought through organisational and public activities; has led and participated in several significant campaigns and yatras on contemporary and ideological issues, including, (i) Subhash Sandesh Jyoti Yatra, 1996, (ii) Shaikshnik Sanghosh Yatra, 2002 and (iii) Azad Sandesh Yatra, 2006-2007; has been actively associated with initiatives aimed at strengthening public awareness on issues of national importance; regularly contributes articles on contemporary political, social and national issues to leading newspapers and magazines; Co-editor, Charaiveti, Deendayal Vichar Prakashan Samiti, 2005-2009
other_information: Joined Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (R.S.S.) in 1988; joined Akhil Bhartiya Vidyarthi Parishad (A.B.V.P.) in 1990; City Convener, A.B.V.P., Mandi Bamora, 1992-1993; Organiser, A.B.V.P., at Sagar University (UTD), 1994-1995; Member, State Executive Council, Mahakoshal, 1995-1996; Co-Convener, A.B.V.P., Sagar District, 1995-1996; 1998-2002 - State Secretary, A.B.V.P. Office, Madhya Bharat, 1998-2002; In charge, A.B.V.P., Bhopal Division, (Bhopal, Vidisha, Raisen, Sehore and Rajgarh), 2000-2002 ; 2002-2003 - State Secretary, A.B.V.P., Madhya Bharat, 2002-2003; Member, National Executive, Bhartiya Janta Yuva Morcha (B.J.Y.M.), 2006-2007; State General Secretary, B.J.Y.M., Madhya Pradesh, 2011-2013; State Vice-President, B.J.Y.M., Madhya Pradesh, 2013; State Spokesperson, B.J.P., Madhya Pradesh, 2014-2021; State Secretary, B.J.P., Madhya Pradesh, 2021-2025 and since 2025; played an active role in election management, campaign planning and organisational strategy during Madhya Pradesh Assembly and Lok Sabha elections, including those held in 2008, 2009, 2013, 2014, 2018, 2019, 2023 and 2024; was In-charge, Booth Vistarak Abhiyan and booth-management activities, 2021-2023; played an important role in booth management and organisational strategy during the Madhya Pradesh Assembly elections, 2023; his core areas of experience include grassroots organisation and cadre development, election management and booth-level strategy, political communication and public outreach, media, journalism and public communication, ideological and intellectual activities, youth mobilisation and organisational leadership, campaign planning and execution, parliamentary affairs and public-policy issues, and contemporary national and social issues
